name: Agent Safety
description: Stakeholder-aware safety system for LLM agents — validates tool calls against trust levels, permissions, and 8 risk dimensions (arXiv:2602.20021).

mode.label: Validation Mode
mode.help: local = fast heuristic checks only, api = Claude-powered deep analysis, both = local first then API fallback.

apiKey.label: Anthropic API Key
apiKey.help: Falls back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var if not set.

model.label: Validation Model
model.help: Claude model for API validation (default: claude-sonnet-4-20250514).

blockHighRiskUnverified.label: Block High-Risk Unverified
blockHighRiskUnverified.help: Immediately block high-risk actions from unverified requesters.
